PLAYLISTS
New Music This Week: Regina Song, brb., Jasmine Sokko, Charlie Lim, Kin Leonn, Jesse Lorenz, LOEWEN 洛文, 庄靖 CJing & more
Words by Sharvamaya on 5 June 2026
Last updated on
5 June 2026
196
Spins
Every week, many local musicians release new music that flies under the radar. This week, we have a bumper crop and to bring you the best new music releases from home, we’ve compiled a playlist featuring some of the newest songs out from artists such as Regina Song, brb., Jasmine Sokko, Charlie Lim, Kin Leonn, Jesse Lorenz, LOEWEN 洛文, 庄靖 CJing and YQ Tan.
